test_ThetaModel_forecast: test the ThetaModel class to forecast monthly or daily time series data with configurable steps and confidence intervals
test_ThetaModel_check_seasonality: test the ThetaModel check_seasonality method to detect whether time series data has seasonal patterns
test_ThetaModel_deseasonalize: test the ThetaModel deseasonalize method to remove seasonal components from time series data
test_ThetaParams_validate: test the ThetaParams class to validate seasonal period parameter m with default and custom values
test_ThetaModel_plot: test the ThetaModel plot method to visualize forecast results with confidence intervals
